context: A toy causal system for validating metadata-only causal discovery runs. Study effort affects exam score, and exam score affects course pass status.

variables.name: StudyEffort
variables.description: How much time and focus a student spends preparing for an exam.

variables.name: ExamScore
variables.description: The student's measured performance on the exam.

variables.name: PassCourse
variables.description: Whether the student passes the course after the exam outcome is determined.
